measurement.placement: S81 canonical + R93 re-placement (one more BF16-capable pair in region 93; each wo_a group one phase)
measurement.stale_note: tools/dsrom_1m_field.py changed on main after the measurement (plan/extract helpers); every RTL source and the bench match main

verdict_reason: cannot close SS at 1.2 GHz (owner rule: new hardware must close SS/FF in context; no rescue loops). Exact: 6,016/6,016 node-region runs bit-exact (170,528 rows), 7 layers, every region. Per-pair hardware closes routed (SS +140.0 ps, FF +5.0 ps). The PQ spine fails SS: -722.8 ps (R=16) / -905.9 ps and FF -10.3 ps (R=128); the same wrapper at PQ=0 (inherited pinned-spine structure) fails -684.1 ps on the same register classes (stream-ROM word loop, pos*ops row address, beat assembly), so closing it needs spine RTL pipelining, not routing.

composed_if_adopted.note: tools/dsrom_1m_allmeasured.py with this record set to ADOPT (main 6617b9607 levers router+draft+head); not applied

physical_cost.slack_basis: routed (ORFS detail route, RCX spef), OpenSTA SS/FF corner_sta; block level, not in the S81 die
physical_cost.congestion_basis: BLOCK-LEVEL route GRT (asap7 M2-M7, adjustment 0.25) of each screen top, 4x4-GCell windows from its 4_cts.odb (physical/dsrom_recovery_field/gcell4x4.sh); NOT the S81 full-die GRT. Boundary tracks added across region/spine: +2 broadcast bits (go_tag) only
physical_cost.s81_rerun_why: element (pair) abstract grows by the per-element area above (banked tags + configuration shadow); one more BF site in region 93 (R93 re-placement); spine gains op slots and a 2-bit wider broadcast; the S81 full-die physical PASS was for the pinned element/spine
physical_cost.area_basis: routed std-cell area difference PQ=1 minus PQ=0 of the same screen tops (pair: per element; spine: per die, R=16 wrapper); 2417 pairs, 128 regions per layer die, 324 S81 layer dies; no macros added. S81 die priced 839.239 mm2 of the 858 mm2 reticle: +1.9786 mm2 fits (margin 18.761 -> 16.782 mm2)
physical_cost.added_spine_wires: broadcast +2 bits (go_tag) through the BST trunk; return tag reuses row bits [15:14] (no new wires); spine flops: 4 op slots (ph, xbase, obase, ops, xps, fmt, 64-bit phase word, rsplit, 19-bit rows-left, np) + since counters + 2-stage per-tag row-count tree
physical_cost.r93_replacement: one more BF16-capable pair site in region 93 of every layer die (519 -> 520): one q element replaced by a BF element (bf vs q element area per S81 floorplan area_mm2_by_kind / counts)

reopen: re-open as a new record when the PQ spine closes SS/FF at 1.2 GHz: prefetch two stream-ROM words (break the sw -> need/have -> next-address loop), register the row-write address (pos*ops) and the root inputs, register since1/2 off the stream-end cone; see results/rtl/dsrom_recovery_20261004/field_pq_ssff.json and field_pq_phys/*_ss_violations_by_register.json
